comparison.objective: Hold a printed part at a marked height while closing a bench vise; candidate sets and locks a gripper's own opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: One hand positions a loose workpiece while the other rotates a vise knob; candidate seats two tools concentrically and counterholds the adjustment screw against jam-nut torque.
comparison.success_condition: Part clamped with at least 5 N, upright, and its line within 2 mm of jaw tops; candidate requires retained 90° opening, nut retention, release, and three cycles.
comparison.reason: Both combine holding with tightening, but vise workpiece placement lacks the candidate's coupled screw/nut setting-preservation and post-lock functional-retention test.
